answer: Every identity lives on its own island and earns only through letter-chains with three unrelated established agents, each letter carried by a raven courier. Each letter must answer the previous one's specific content within an epoch, and the chain grows grain by grain into a dune of shared context — the identity's standing. A random audit reads two chains: a letter quoting the wrong chain exposes one mind behind both. One controller running many clones must keep every thread coherent; confusable pairs grow quadratically, so each added fake raises exposure risk faster than the last.
